notes: PSC Master's Scholarships is a national government scheme (Public Service Commission, psc.gov.sg). The official page states holders 'may study at local or overseas universities; and choose to read from a diverse range of courses relevant to the Public Service (subject to PSC's approval)' - the scholar selects the university, so there is no attached institution, programme, or supervising professor. No professor enrichment is applicable.

MOE Teaching Scholarships/Award (Full-Term) is a national government scholarship administered by the Ministry of Education and the Public Service Commission for entry into the Singapore Education Service as a teacher. The official MOE application page describes only application windows, interviews and outcomes - no university faculty or supervising professor is attached to the scheme. No professor enrichment is applicable.

A*STAR International Fellowship (AIF) is a national postdoctoral fellowship administered by A*STAR Graduate Academy (a-star.edu.sg). Fellows receive 'up to 2 years of overseas postdoctoral training' at a leading overseas university/lab chosen by the applicant; the official FAQ states 'you should contact an overseas university/institution supervisor to establish a project proposal prior to applying for AIF'. No institution or named supervising professor is attached to the fellowship itself, so no professor enrichment is applicable.

NUS Undergraduate Scholarship (NUS Scholarships for Freshmen, Singapore Citizens) is an undergraduate merit scholarship administered by the NUS Office of Admissions. The official page (nus.edu.sg/oam) describes only tuition fee coverage, bond-free terms and exchange benefits; no faculty, supervisor or programme professor is tied to the award. Undergraduate merit scholarships have no supervising professor structure.

Nanyang Merit Scholarship is an undergraduate merit scholarship administered by the NTU Office of Admissions. The official NTU page lists eligibility, benefits (full tuition fee coverage, S$5,000 living allowance, travel grant) and application procedures only - no professor, supervisor or faculty mentor is attached to the award. The school teacher who completes the referee's appraisal is not university faculty.

NTU President Award is an undergraduate leadership award administered by the NTU Office of Admissions. The official NTU page lists eligibility, benefits (study allowance, campus housing, mentoring opportunities with NTU Senior Management and Notable Alumni, enrolment into NTU Honours College) and application procedures only - no named supervising professor or faculty supervisor is published for this award.

SMU Global Impact Scholarship Award is SMU's flagship undergraduate scholarship administered by the Office of Admissions and Financial Assistance. The official SMU page describes the scholarship features, eligibility, benefits and application process; the only named individual on the page is Allan Schulte (VP, Bain & Company Southeast Asia, Head of Recruiting), an industry supporter quoted in endorsement - not university faculty. No supervising professor is attached to this undergraduate award.
